title: CPU-native math dependency profile
objective: Implement a fingerprinted opt-in CPU-native GMP/FLINT source-build profile while retaining the portable default, expose complete build provenance, and validate identity without expensive rebuilds

handoff.summary: Added an opt-in cpu-native mathematics dependency profile while retaining portable release/source defaults. FLINT and FFLAS builders share one deterministic identity; native cache keys separate portable and CPU-native artifacts; dependency stamps record the selected profile and observed FLINT fft_small capability; `sagejs native profile [--json]` exposes selected-versus-installed provenance.
risks: A full CPU-native dependency rebuild was intentionally not run in this lane because it is expensive; compiler flags, configure options, stamp reuse, and fingerprints are covered without rebuilding. The next controlled performance run should build once and record `sagejs native profile --json`.

The source worktree lacked its m4ri prefix during a final full build, so production native-kernel publication stopped after compiler/runtime caches. This is an environment provisioning gap unrelated to the profile; focused CLI tests use the successfully rebuilt compiler.
The integration lane must add test/native-math-profile.cjs to test/node-test-manifest.cjs after the automatic-cache lane lands, since that lane owns the shared manifest.
next_steps: Build FLINT and FFLAS on a controlled benchmark host with SAGEJS_NATIVE_MATH_PROFILE=cpu-native, record profile JSON, and compare representative exact arithmetic benchmarks with the portable build.
Add test/native-math-profile.cjs to the unit/portable host-test manifest during integration.
